summary.zh-CN: 清晨，一位妈妈抱着6岁的儿子来到儿科急诊：孩子感冒两天后，昨夜咳嗽、喘息越来越重。请评估病情、实时处理、观察反应，并与焦虑的妈妈一起制定安全的离院计划。病情会随时间和你的处理而变化。
summary.en: Early in the morning a mother carries her 6-year-old son into the paediatric emergency department: after two days of a cold, his cough and wheeze got steadily worse overnight. Assess him, treat in real time, watch the response and build a safe plan with his anxious mother. His condition changes with time and with what you do.

notes.zh-CN: 为 ClinicalCraft V5 编写的虚构教学病例，不基于任何真实患者；人名均为化名。处理依据 GINA 2024、BTS/SIGN 158 及中国儿童哮喘指南（2016）/建议（2020）。
notes.en: Synthetic teaching case written for ClinicalCraft V5; not based on any real patient; all names are pseudonyms. Management follows GINA 2024, BTS/SIGN 158 and the Chinese paediatric asthma guideline (2016) / recommendations (2020).

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

triageNote.zh-CN: 06:05 分诊：6岁男孩，20 kg（已称重），妈妈陪同。感冒2天，昨夜咳嗽、呼吸费力加重。RR 38次/分，HR 140次/分，吸空气SpO₂ 90%，T 37.6 ℃。只能说短语。分诊2级（急重），已安置在抢救区并接监护。
triageNote.en: 06:05 triage: 6-year-old boy, 20 kg (weighed), with his mother. 2-day cold; cough and laboured breathing worse overnight. RR 38/min, HR 140/min, SpO₂ 90% in room air, T 37.6 °C. Speaking in phrases. Triage category 2 (very urgent); placed in a resus cubicle on the monitor.

personality.zh-CN: 平时活泼好动、喜欢踢足球和看动画片；现在胆小、紧紧依偎着妈妈。
personality.en: Normally lively, loves football and cartoons; right now timid and clinging to his mum.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 喘得厉害时一次只能说两三个字，用儿童语言（“胸口紧紧的”“好累”）；好转后能说完整句子，会问能不能回家。
speechStyle.en: While breathless he manages only two or three words at a time in a child's vocabulary ('chest tight', 'tired'); once better he talks in full sentences and asks to go home.

openingLine.zh-CN: （孩子抓着妈妈的衣服，断断续续地说）“喘……不过气……” 妈妈：“医生，他前两天感冒，昨晚后半夜越喘越厉害，现在连一句完整的话都说不出来了！”
openingLine.en: (The boy grips his mother's top and gasps) “Can't… breathe…” Mother: “Doctor, he's had a cold for two days and since the middle of the night his breathing has got worse and worse — now he can't even finish a sentence!”

fallbackUnknown.en: (Mother) I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: 他会不会又要像4岁那次一样住院？
concerns.en: Will he have to stay in hospital again like when he was 4?

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是因为我把那个橙色的预防药停了才这样？
concerns.en: Is this because I stopped the orange preventer?

concerns.zh-CN: 用这么多激素会不会影响他长个子？
concerns.en: Will all these steroids affect his growth?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 孩子：喘得厉害，前倾坐在妈妈腿上，每次只说两三个字；开始害怕面罩，妈妈抱着时会安静下来；病情好转后说话越来越流利、开始要水喝、要玩平板。妈妈：焦虑、语速快，对停药感到内疚，担心激素副作用，听到解释后逐渐平静，愿意学习。病史主要由妈妈回答；孩子只回答直接问他的简单问题。若病情恶化（护士说他精疲力竭、开始犯困）：孩子不再说话、不再哭闹，只是靠在妈妈身上、眼睛时开时闭，无法回答问题；妈妈变得非常害怕。
actingNotes.en: Child: very breathless, leaning forward on mum's lap, two or three words at a time; scared of the mask at first but settles when mum holds him; as he improves he talks more freely, asks for a drink and his tablet. Mother: anxious and fast-talking, guilty about stopping the preventer, worried about steroid side-effects; calms as things are explained and is keen to learn. The mother gives most of the history; the child answers only simple questions put directly to him. If he deteriorates (the nurse says he is exhausted and getting drowsy): the child stops talking and crying, just slumps against his mother with his eyes closing and can no longer answer; his mother becomes very frightened.

persona.zh-CN: 34岁，超市收银员。焦虑、语速快，对没坚持给孩子用预防药很自责；担心激素影响生长，希望“打点滴、用消炎药”；理解力中等，愿意学习。
persona.en: 34-year-old supermarket cashier. Anxious and talks fast; feels guilty about not keeping up the preventer; worried steroids will affect growth and expects 'a drip and antibiotics'; average health literacy and keen to learn.

description.zh-CN: 06:10起：初始评估与第一小时强化治疗。病情随时间和处理实时变化。
description.en: From 06:10: initial assessment and first-hour intensive treatment. His condition evolves in real time with your management.

description.zh-CN: 完成第一小时的3轮支气管舒张剂后（≥60分钟）自动进入：再评估治疗反应。若治疗开始前已出现疲劳，须先针对反应差升级治疗（静脉硫酸镁）。
description.en: Entered automatically once the first hour's three bronchodilator rounds are done (≥ 60 min): reassess the response. If he was tiring before treatment started, the poor response must first be escalated (IV magnesium).

description.zh-CN: 到院约4小时、完成再评估、已用全身激素且吸空气SpO₂恢复到≥95%后自动进入：核对出院标准、宣教与随访。
description.en: Entered automatically about 4 hours after arrival once the reassessment is complete, he has had his systemic steroid and his room-air SpO₂ is back to ≥ 95%: check discharge criteria, education and follow-up.

description.zh-CN: 支气管舒张剂延误、病情恶化时自动进入：立即重新评估、呼叫上级并升级治疗。
description.en: Entered automatically if he deteriorates after bronchodilator treatment is delayed: reassess at once, call for senior help and escalate.

question.zh-CN: 这次是什么时候开始喘的？是怎么加重的？
question.en: When did the breathing trouble start, and how has it changed?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）他前两天就感冒了。昨晚12点左右开始咳嗽、喘，后半夜越来越厉害，大概3点以后就躺不下去了，一直坐着喘。到早上5点多，他喘得连一句完整的话都说不出来，我就赶紧带他来了。
answer.en: (Mother) He's had a cold for a couple of days. Around midnight last night he started coughing and wheezing, and it kept getting worse — after about 3 a.m. he couldn't lie down and just sat up breathing hard. By a bit after 5 he couldn't get a whole sentence out, so I brought him straight in.

en: how long has he had asthma

question.zh-CN: 发作前这几天有没有感冒、流鼻涕之类的？
question.en: Did he have a cold or any illness in the days before this?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）有，前两天开始流清鼻涕、打喷嚏，有点咳。他妹妹在幼儿园也感冒了，估计是她传给他的。
answer.en: (Mother) Yes — two days ago he started with a runny nose, sneezing and a bit of a cough. His little sister caught a cold at nursery, so probably from her.

question.zh-CN: 从昨晚到现在用了几次蓝色的急救喷雾？效果怎么样？
question.en: How much of his blue reliever inhaler has he had since last night, and did it help?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）蓝色的万托林。我半夜1点给他喷了2下，3点又喷了2下，5点又喷了2下。每次能好半个小时左右，然后又喘起来。储雾罐找不到，就直接对着嘴喷的。
answer.en: (Mother) The blue Ventolin. I gave him 2 puffs at about 1 a.m., 2 more at 3 and another 2 at 5. Each time it helped for maybe half an hour, then he was wheezy again. We couldn't find the spacer, so I sprayed it straight into his mouth.

question.zh-CN: 这次来之前去过别的医院或诊所吗？用过什么治疗？
question.en: Before coming here, has he been seen anywhere else for this attack, or had any other treatment?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有，这次没去过别的医院或诊所，是直接从家里过来的。除了在家喷的万托林和昨天在药店买的止咳糖浆，没打过针、没输过液，也没吃过别的药。
answer.en: (Mother) No — we haven't been anywhere else this time; we came straight here from home. Apart from the Ventolin at home and the cough syrup from the pharmacy yesterday, he hasn't had any injections, drips or other medicines.

en: seen by a doctor before coming

question.zh-CN: 他能吃东西、喝水吗？有没有呕吐？小便怎么样？
question.en: Is he eating and drinking? Any vomiting? Has he passed urine?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）从半夜到现在只喝了几口水，早饭不肯吃。没有吐。早上起来尿过一次。
answer.en: (Mother) He's only had a few sips of water since midnight and wouldn't eat breakfast. No vomiting. He did a wee once this morning.

question.zh-CN: 平时没发作的时候，晚上咳醒、运动后喘的情况多吗？急救喷雾一周用几次？
question.en: Between attacks, how often does he cough at night or wheeze with exercise, and how often does he need the blue inhaler?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）最近一个月，一周大概有两三个晚上咳醒；在学校跑完步会喘，体育课有时候要停下来。蓝色喷雾一周要用三四次。
answer.en: (Mother) Over the last month he's woken coughing two or three nights a week, and he gets wheezy after running at school — sometimes he has to stop in PE. He uses the blue inhaler three or four times a week.

question.zh-CN: 咳嗽是什么样的？有没有痰或者咳血？
question.en: What is the cough like? Any phlegm or blood?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）干咳，一阵一阵的，晚上特别厉害，有时候咳得想吐，但没吐出来。没有痰，也没有血。
answer.en: (Mother) A dry, hacking cough that comes in fits, much worse at night. Sometimes he coughs so hard he gags, but he hasn't been sick. No phlegm and no blood.

question.zh-CN: 有没有发烧？最高多少度？
question.en: Has he had a fever? How high?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）昨天傍晚摸着有点热，量了腋温37.8 ℃，没吃退烧药。没有打寒战。
answer.en: (Mother) He felt a bit warm yesterday evening — I took it under his arm and it was 37.8 °C. I didn't give him anything for it. No shivering.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有说胸口痛？在哪里，是什么样的痛？
question.en: Has he complained of chest pain? Where, and what is it like?

answer.zh-CN: （孩子指着胸口正中）“紧紧的……好累……” 妈妈：“他没说过哪一边刺痛，就是说胸口闷、紧。”
answer.en: (The boy points to the middle of his chest) “Tight… tired…” Mother: “He hasn't said anything about a sharp pain on one side — just that his chest feels tight.”

question.zh-CN: 他今天精神怎么样？有没有特别犯困、叫不醒或者说胡话？
question.en: How alert has he been — any unusual sleepiness, confusion or floppiness?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）他人是清醒的，认得我，跟他说话会回答，没有迷迷糊糊或者说胡话。昨晚几乎没睡，但不是那种叫不醒的困。
answer.en: (Mother) He's awake and knows what's going on — he answers when you talk to him. He isn't drowsy or confused; he barely slept last night, but he's not the kind of sleepy where you can't wake him.

question.zh-CN: 他现在精神怎么样？是不是越来越困？
question.en: How alert is he now — is he getting sleepier?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）他越来越没劲了，眼睛老是闭上，也不哭不闹了……医生，他这样不对劲啊！
answer.en: (Mother) He's getting weaker and weaker — his eyes keep closing and he's stopped crying… Doctor, this isn't like him at all!

question.zh-CN: 发作前有没有呛咳、误吸异物，或者是突然起病的？
question.en: Was there any choking episode or chance he inhaled something — did it start suddenly?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有，没呛着过，也不是在吃东西或玩小玩具的时候突然开始的。就是感冒以后慢慢加重的。
answer.en: (Mother) No, nothing like that — he didn't choke, and it didn't start suddenly while he was eating or playing with small toys. It came on gradually after the cold.

question.zh-CN: 吸气时有没有怪声（喉鸣）、声音嘶哑或流口水？
question.en: Any noisy breathing when breathing in, a hoarse voice or drooling?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）主要是呼气的时候有“咝咝”的哨音，吸气的时候没有那种怪声。声音不哑，也没流口水。
answer.en: (Mother) The whistling is mostly when he breathes out — no strange noise when he breathes in. His voice isn't hoarse and he isn't drooling.

question.zh-CN: 有没有皮疹、嘴唇或脸肿？最近吃过新的食物、用过新药或被虫咬过吗？
question.en: Any rash, lip or face swelling, new foods or medicines, or insect stings recently?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有皮疹，也没肿。昨晚吃的是平常的米饭、青菜和鱼，鱼他吃过很多次了。除了止咳糖浆没用过新药，也没被虫咬。
answer.en: (Mother) No rash and no swelling. Last night he had his usual rice, vegetables and fish — he's had fish lots of times. No new medicines apart from the cough syrup, and no stings.

en: what did he eat last night

question.zh-CN: 他是什么时候、怎么被诊断为哮喘的？
question.en: When and how was his asthma diagnosed?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）4岁的时候。他每次感冒都喘，后来儿童医院呼吸科的医生说是哮喘，用了喷雾就好转了。
answer.en: (Mother) When he was 4. He used to wheeze with every cold, and the respiratory doctor at the children's hospital said it was asthma — he got better with the inhalers.

en: how long has he had asthma

question.zh-CN: 以前因为哮喘看过急诊或住过院吗？
question.en: Has he been to the emergency department or admitted to hospital for asthma before?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）这一年来了两次急诊，都是感冒以后，雾化完开了激素糖浆就回家了。4岁那次住过一次院，在普通儿科病房住了3天，吸了氧。
answer.en: (Mother) Twice in the past year we came to emergency, both times after a cold — they gave him nebulisers and steroid syrup and sent us home. And he was admitted once when he was 4: three days on the children's ward, on oxygen.

question.zh-CN: 有没有进过重症监护室（ICU），或者插管上过呼吸机？
question.en: Has he ever needed intensive care or a breathing tube/ventilator?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有，从来没进过ICU，也没插过管。
answer.en: (Mother) No — never intensive care, never a breathing tube.

question.zh-CN: 过去一年吃过几次口服激素？
question.en: How many courses of steroid tablets or syrup has he had in the past year?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）两次，就是那两次急诊之后，每次吃3天的激素糖浆。
answer.en: (Mother) Twice — after each of those two emergency visits, three days of steroid syrup each time.

question.zh-CN: 医生给他开的每天用的预防药（控制药）是什么？怎么用？
question.en: What regular preventer (controller) medicine is he prescribed, and how should he take it?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）橙色的那个，辅舒酮，就是氟替卡松。医生说每天早晚各喷1下，要用储雾罐。
answer.en: (Mother) The orange one — Flixotide, fluticasone. The doctor said one puff morning and night, through the spacer.

question.zh-CN: 这个预防药他实际上每天都在用吗？
question.en: Is he actually taking the preventer every day?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）说实话……没有。我只在他喘的时候才给他喷。大概两个月前用完了，我看他挺好的，又担心天天用激素不好，就没再去开。
answer.en: (Mother) Honestly… no. I only give it when he's wheezy. It ran out about two months ago — he seemed fine, and I was worried about using steroids every day, so I didn't get more.

en: how often does he take his preventer
when did he stop his preventer
how long since he stopped his preventer

question.zh-CN: 平时喷药用储雾罐吗？是怎么吸的？
question.en: Does he use a spacer? How does he take his inhaler?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）家里有一个带面罩的储雾罐，但大多放在抽屉里。平时就是直接往他嘴里喷一下，他吸一口就完了。
answer.en: (Mother) We have a spacer with a mask, but it mostly stays in a drawer. Usually I just spray it into his mouth and he takes one breath.

en: how does he use his inhaler

question.zh-CN: 家里有雾化机吗？在家做过雾化吗？
question.en: Do you have a nebuliser machine at home? Has he had a neb at home?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）家里没有雾化机，只有那个蓝色的和橙色的喷雾，昨晚也没给他做过雾化。
answer.en: (Mother) We don't have a nebuliser at home — just the blue and the orange inhalers. He hasn't had a neb at home.

question.zh-CN: 还在用其他药吗？包括药店买的或中药？
question.en: Is he taking any other medicines — including over-the-counter or herbal remedies?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）昨天在药店买了一瓶儿童止咳糖浆，给他喝了两次，名字我不记得了。没有别的药，也没吃中药。
answer.en: (Mother) Yesterday I bought a children's cough syrup at the pharmacy and gave him two doses — I can't remember the name. Nothing else, no herbal medicines.

question.zh-CN: 他对什么药物或食物过敏吗？
question.en: Does he have any allergies to medicines or foods?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有已知的药物过敏，食物也不过敏。
answer.en: (Mother) No medicine allergies that we know of, and no food allergies.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有湿疹、过敏性鼻炎之类的情况？
question.en: Does he have eczema, hay fever or other allergic conditions?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）小时候手肘、膝盖窝长过湿疹，现在基本好了。春天老打喷嚏、揉鼻子。
answer.en: (Mother) He had eczema in the creases of his elbows and knees as a baby — mostly gone now. In spring he sneezes and rubs his nose a lot.

question.zh-CN: 除了哮喘，他还有别的病吗？做过手术吗？
question.en: Apart from asthma, does he have any other medical problems, or has he had any operations?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有别的病，就是小时候长过湿疹。也没做过手术。
answer.en: (Mother) Nothing else — just the eczema when he was little. He's never had an operation.

question.zh-CN: 他出生时的情况怎么样？足月吗？
question.en: Tell me about his birth — was he born at term?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）足月顺产，3.3公斤，生下来呼吸没问题，没住过新生儿病房。
answer.en: (Mother) Full term, normal delivery, 3.3 kg. No breathing problems after birth and no neonatal unit.

question.zh-CN: 他生长发育和上学情况怎么样？
question.en: How are his growth, development and school?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）长得跟同龄孩子差不多，说话走路都正常。今年9月上了小学一年级，学习还行，喜欢踢足球。这学期因为咳嗽请过3天假。
answer.en: (Mother) He's growing like other kids his age; talking and walking were all normal. He started Year 1 at primary school in September, doing fine, and loves football. He's missed 3 days this term because of the cough.

question.zh-CN: 疫苗都按时打了吗？今年打流感疫苗了吗？
question.en: Are his vaccinations up to date? Has he had a flu vaccine this year?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）计划内的疫苗都按时打了。今年的流感疫苗还没打。
answer.en: (Mother) All his routine vaccines are done on schedule. He hasn't had this year's flu vaccine yet.

question.zh-CN: 家里有人有哮喘、过敏或湿疹吗？
question.en: Does anyone in the family have asthma, allergies or eczema?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）他爸爸小时候有哮喘，现在还有过敏性鼻炎。妹妹3岁，有湿疹。
answer.en: (Mother) His dad had asthma as a child and still has hay fever. His little sister is 3 and has eczema.

question.zh-CN: 家里有人抽烟吗？
question.en: Does anyone smoke at home or around him?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）他爸爸抽烟，说是只在阳台抽……不过我经常在他衣服上闻到烟味。
answer.en: (Mother) His dad smokes — he says only on the balcony… but I often smell it on his clothes.

question.zh-CN: 家里都有谁？住的环境怎么样？养宠物吗？
question.en: Who lives at home, what is the home like, and are there any pets?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）我、他爸爸、妹妹和奶奶住在一起，住6楼的公寓。家里没养宠物，奶奶帮忙带孩子。
answer.en: (Mother) Me, his dad, his sister and his grandma, in a 6th-floor flat. No pets. Grandma helps look after the kids.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有出远门或旅行？
question.en: Has he travelled anywhere recently?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有，最近哪儿也没去，就是上学、回家。
answer.en: (Mother) No, we haven't been anywhere — just school and home.

question.zh-CN: 平时什么情况容易诱发他喘？
question.en: What usually sets off his asthma?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）主要是感冒，还有跑得太猛、吸了冷空气。去他姑姑家（她家养猫）待久了也会喘。
answer.en: (Mother) Mostly colds — also running hard and cold air. If we stay long at his aunt's house (she has a cat) he gets wheezy too.

question.zh-CN: 医生给过你们书面的哮喘行动计划吗？
question.en: Have you been given a written asthma action plan?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）没有，没人给过我们书面的东西。我就知道喘了用蓝色的。家里也没有测峰流速的那个仪器。
answer.en: (Mother) No, nobody's given us anything written. I just know to use the blue one when he's wheezy. We don't have a peak flow meter at home either.

question.zh-CN: 你现在最担心的是什么？
question.en: What are you most worried about?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）我怕他又要住院……还有，用这么多激素会不会影响他长个子？其实我也很自责，是不是因为我把那个橙色的药停了才这样。
answer.en: (Mother) I'm scared he'll have to stay in hospital again… and will all these steroids stunt his growth? Honestly I feel terrible — is this because I stopped the orange one?

question.zh-CN: 你希望今天我们为他做些什么？
question.en: What were you hoping we would do for him today?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）先让他喘得好一点……他发烧了，是不是要打点滴、用消炎药（抗生素）？
answer.en: (Mother) First just get his breathing better… and he's had a fever — does he need a drip, or antibiotics?

en: what would you like us to do

question.zh-CN: 他现在体重多少？
question.en: How much does he weigh?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）刚才分诊称了，20公斤。上个月体检也差不多这个数。
answer.en: (Mother) They weighed him at triage — 20 kg. It was about the same at his check-up last month.

question.zh-CN: （问孩子）小朋友，你现在哪里不舒服？
question.en: (To the child) How are you feeling, buddy?

answer.zh-CN: （孩子喘着气，一次只能说两三个字）“喘……不过气……胸口……紧……”
answer.en: (The boy, panting, two or three words at a time) “Can't… breathe… chest… tight…”

question.zh-CN: （问孩子）小朋友，你现在感觉怎么样？
question.en: (To the child) How are you feeling, buddy?

answer.zh-CN: （孩子没有力气回答，只是微微睁眼看了你一下，又闭上眼睛，轻轻摇了摇头。）
answer.en: (He's too exhausted to answer — he opens his eyes briefly, looks at you, closes them again and gives a tiny shake of the head.)

question.zh-CN: （问孩子）现在感觉好点了吗？
question.en: (To the child) Are you feeling better now?

answer.zh-CN: （孩子）“好多了……就是手有点抖，心跳得好快。”
answer.en: (The boy) “Much better… my hands are a bit shaky and my heart's going fast.”

question.zh-CN: （问孩子）现在感觉怎么样？
question.en: (To the child) How are you feeling now?

answer.zh-CN: （孩子）“我不喘了！我能回家看动画片吗？”
answer.en: (The boy) “I'm not wheezy any more! Can I go home and watch cartoons?”

question.zh-CN: 他做过肺功能检查吗？结果怎么样？
question.en: Has he ever had lung function tests (spirometry)? What did they show?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）这个我真的记不清了，不知道有没有做过，结果就更不知道了。
answer.en: (Mother) I honestly can't remember whether he's had that, let alone what it showed.

question.zh-CN: 家里潮湿吗？有没有发霉？
question.en: Is the home damp or mouldy?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）这个我没注意过，不太清楚。
answer.en: (Mother) I've never really noticed — I don't know.

question.zh-CN: 蓝色喷雾里还剩多少药？过期了吗？
question.en: How much is left in the blue inhaler, and is it in date?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）这个不知道……瓶子上没有计数器，我也没数过喷了多少下，有效期也没看过。
answer.en: (Mother) No idea… it doesn't have a counter, I've never counted the puffs, and I haven't checked the expiry date.

question.zh-CN: 他上一次去哮喘专科（或医生那里）做常规复查是什么时候？
question.en: When did he last have a routine asthma check-up with his doctor or the asthma clinic?

answer.zh-CN: （妈妈）具体什么时候我记不清了，挺久了……最近都是喘厉害了才来急诊。
answer.en: (Mother) I honestly can't remember when — it's been a while… lately we've only come to the emergency department when he's bad.

maneuver.zh-CN: 观察一般情况（意识、面色、体位）

finding.zh-CN: 患儿坐在母亲腿上，身体前倾、双手撑膝（三脚架体位），表情紧张害怕；神志清楚，对答切题；面色稍苍白，口唇红润，无发绀；轻度鼻翼扇动。
finding.en: Sitting on his mother's lap, leaning forward with hands on his knees (tripod position), anxious and frightened; alert and responds appropriately; a little pale, lips pink — no cyanosis; mild nasal flaring.

maneuver.zh-CN: 评估说话能力（能否一口气说完整句子）
maneuver.en: Assess speech (can he finish a sentence in one breath?)

finding.zh-CN: 只能说2–4个字的短语，说一句话要停下来换气好几次，不能一口气说完一句完整的话。
finding.en: Speaks only in short 2–4-word phrases, stopping to breathe several times; cannot complete a sentence in one breath.

maneuver.zh-CN: 视诊呼吸做功（呼吸频率、三凹征、辅助呼吸肌）
maneuver.en: Inspect work of breathing (rate, recession, accessory muscles)

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸急促，呼气相明显延长；可见胸骨上窝凹陷（气管牵拽）、肋间隙及肋下凹陷；无胸腹矛盾运动；颈部斜角肌未见、也未触及明显收缩。
finding.en: Tachypnoeic with a markedly prolonged expiratory phase; suprasternal retraction (tracheal tug), intercostal and subcostal recession; no see-saw breathing; no visible or palpable scalene muscle contraction.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺广泛高调多音性哮鸣音，吸气相与呼气相均可闻及；双肺呼吸音普遍减低（两侧对称），呼气相延长；未闻及湿啰音；没有呼吸音消失的区域（不是“沉默肺”）。
finding.en: Widespread high-pitched polyphonic wheeze on both inspiration and expiration; air entry diffusely reduced throughout both lungs (symmetrical) with prolonged expiration; no crackles; no area of absent breath sounds (not a silent chest).

maneuver.zh-CN: 胸廓视诊、气管位置与皮下气肿检查
maneuver.en: Chest shape, tracheal position and check for surgical emphysema

finding.zh-CN: 胸廓稍饱满（过度充气），两侧起伏对称；气管居中；颈部及胸壁未触及捻发感（无皮下气肿）。
finding.en: Chest looks mildly hyperinflated, moving symmetrically; trachea central; no crepitus over the neck or chest wall (no surgical emphysema).

finding.zh-CN: 双肺叩诊呈过清音，两侧对称，未叩及浊音。
finding.en: Hyper-resonant to percussion bilaterally and symmetrically; no dullness.

maneuver.zh-CN: 心血管检查（心音、脉搏、毛细血管再充盈）
maneuver.en: Cardiovascular exam (heart sounds, pulses, capillary refill)

finding.zh-CN: 心律齐，心音有力，未闻及杂音；外周脉搏有力；中心毛细血管再充盈时间<2秒；四肢温暖。
finding.en: Regular rhythm, heart sounds normal, no murmurs; good-volume peripheral pulses; central capillary refill < 2 s; warm peripheries.

finding.zh-CN: 口唇稍干，眼窝不凹陷，皮肤弹性正常，哭时有泪；无明显脱水。
finding.en: Lips slightly dry; eyes not sunken, normal skin turgor, tears present — no significant dehydration.

finding.zh-CN: 鼻腔可见清亮分泌物；咽部轻度充血，扁桃体不大，无渗出；双侧鼓膜完整、光锥清楚，无充血或膨隆。
finding.en: Clear nasal discharge; pharynx mildly injected, tonsils not enlarged, no exudate; both tympanic membranes intact with a normal light reflex, not red or bulging.

maneuver.zh-CN: 上气道评估（喉鸣、声音、流涎）

finding.zh-CN: 无吸气性喉鸣；声音正常，不嘶哑；无流涎，吞咽正常。
finding.en: No inspiratory stridor; normal, non-hoarse voice; no drooling; swallowing normally.

finding.zh-CN: 双侧颈前可触及数个黄豆大小、活动、无压痛的淋巴结。
finding.en: A few small (pea-sized), mobile, non-tender anterior cervical nodes on both sides.

maneuver.zh-CN: 皮肤检查（皮疹、肿胀、湿疹）

finding.zh-CN: 全身未见皮疹或荨麻疹，无口唇、颜面肿胀；双侧肘窝皮肤稍干燥粗糙（陈旧湿疹）。
finding.en: No rash or urticaria anywhere; no lip or facial swelling; slightly dry, rough skin in both elbow creases (old eczema).

finding.zh-CN: 腹软，无压痛；肝下缘于右肋缘下约1 cm可触及，质软（过度充气的肺使肝脏下移）；脾未触及。
finding.en: Soft, non-tender; liver edge palpable about 1 cm below the right costal margin, soft (pushed down by hyperinflated lungs); spleen not palpable.

finding.zh-CN: 清醒（AVPU：A），GCS 15分；认得妈妈，能回答简单问题；虽然害怕，但妈妈抱着能安抚下来，无躁动；无嗜睡，无意识模糊。
finding.en: Alert (AVPU: A), GCS 15; recognises his mother and answers simple questions; frightened but settles in his mother's arms — not agitated; not drowsy, not confused.

finding.zh-CN: 体重 20 kg（分诊时已称），身高 116 cm（均约在同龄第50百分位附近）。
finding.en: Weight 20 kg (weighed at triage), height 116 cm (both around the 50th centile for age).

maneuver.zh-CN: 再评估一般情况和说话能力

finding.zh-CN: 坐在床上，能说完整的句子，主动要水喝；神志清楚，比之前放松；双手有细微震颤；面色红润。
finding.en: Sitting up in bed, talking in full sentences and asking for a drink; alert and much more relaxed; fine tremor of both hands; good colour.

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸较前明显平稳；仅见轻度肋下凹陷，胸骨上窝凹陷已消失；无斜角肌收缩；无鼻翼扇动。
finding.en: Breathing much more settled; only mild subcostal recession; suprasternal retraction has resolved; no scalene muscle use; no nasal flaring.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺进气较前明显改善，仅双肺底稍减低；散在呼气相哮鸣音，吸气相未闻及；无湿啰音。
finding.en: Air entry much improved, only slightly reduced at both bases; scattered expiratory wheeze, none on inspiration; no crackles.

maneuver.zh-CN: 观察母子使用气雾剂+储雾罐的方法
maneuver.en: Watch mother and child use the inhaler with the spacer

finding.zh-CN: 妈妈习惯直接对着嘴喷，而且连按2下；孩子吸气太快、不屏气。改用带阀储雾罐（口含嘴，他已不需要面罩）：每次只按1揿，随后平静呼吸5–6次——经示范后他能正确完成。
finding.en: Mother tends to spray straight into his mouth and presses twice in a row; he breathes in too fast without holding. With a valved spacer and mouthpiece (he no longer needs the mask) — one puff at a time, then 5–6 calm breaths — he does it correctly after a demonstration.

finding.zh-CN: 精神好，坐在床上玩平板、吃饼干，说话流利；无鼻翼扇动，无三凹征；手抖已不明显。
finding.en: Bright, playing on a tablet and eating crackers, talking freely; no nasal flaring or recession; tremor no longer noticeable.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音清晰、对称，进气良好；平静呼吸时无哮鸣音，仅在用力呼气时偶闻少许呼气末哮鸣音；无湿啰音。
finding.en: Good, symmetrical air entry; no wheeze during quiet breathing — only an occasional faint end-expiratory wheeze on forced expiration; no crackles.

maneuver.zh-CN: 观察一般情况（意识、面色、体位）

finding.zh-CN: 疲惫地瘫靠在妈妈怀里，不再挣扎哭闹，两次呼吸之间眼睛会闭上；面色苍白，口唇发暗（轻度中心性发绀）；鼻翼扇动。
finding.en: Slumped exhausted against his mother, no longer crying or struggling, eyes closing between breaths; pale with dusky lips (mild central cyanosis); nasal flaring.

maneuver.zh-CN: 评估说话能力（能否一口气说完整句子）
maneuver.en: Assess speech (can he finish a sentence in one breath?)

finding.zh-CN: 已经说不出话——最多挤出一个字，大多只能点头或摇头。
finding.en: Can no longer talk — at most a single word; mostly nods or shakes his head.

maneuver.zh-CN: 视诊呼吸做功（呼吸频率、三凹征、辅助呼吸肌）
maneuver.en: Inspect work of breathing (rate, recession, accessory muscles)

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸浅、费力却无力：胸廓起伏减小，胸骨上窝及肋间凹陷仍明显，可见胸锁乳突肌/斜角肌收缩和点头样呼吸；呼吸频率较前下降是疲劳的表现，并非好转。
finding.en: Shallow, laboured but weak breathing: reduced chest movement, marked suprasternal and intercostal recession, visible sternomastoid/scalene contraction and head bobbing; the falling respiratory rate reflects exhaustion, not improvement.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音明显减弱、几乎听不到，仅闻及微弱的呼气相哮鸣音——接近“沉默肺”，是危险信号；无湿啰音。
finding.en: Air entry markedly reduced to minimal on both sides with only a faint expiratory wheeze — an almost silent chest, an ominous sign; no crackles.

finding.zh-CN: 嗜睡，呼唤能睁眼（AVPU：V），GCS 14（E3 V5 M6）；仍认得妈妈，但反应变慢，不再害怕或挣扎。
finding.en: Drowsy, opens his eyes to voice (AVPU: V), GCS 14 (E3 V5 M6); still recognises his mother but responds slowly and is no longer frightened or struggling.

examNotRecorded.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这项检查。
examNotRecorded.en: This examination is not recorded for this case.

name.zh-CN: PRAM 儿童呼吸评估评分

text.zh-CN: PRAM 8/12（重度，8–12分）：胸骨上窝凹陷 2（有）；斜角肌收缩 0（无）；进气 2（双肺普遍减低）；哮鸣音 2（吸气相和呼气相均有）；SpO₂（吸空气，分诊时）90% → 2（<92%）。
text.en: PRAM 8/12 (severe range 8–12): suprasternal retraction 2 (present); scalene contraction 0 (absent); air entry 2 (widespread decrease); wheeze 2 (inspiratory and expiratory); SpO₂ in room air (triage) 90% → 2 (< 92%).

refText.zh-CN: 0 正常 / 1 肺底↓ / 2 广泛↓ / 3 消失或极微弱
0 无 / 1 仅呼气相 / 2 吸气相+呼气相 / 3 不用听诊器即可闻及或沉默肺
refText.en: 0 absent / 1 expiratory / 2 insp+exp / 3 audible without stethoscope or silent chest

note.zh-CN: PRAM 适用于2–17岁儿童，用于分级和追踪治疗反应；SpO₂ 一项按吸空气时的数值计分。不要为评分延误治疗。
note.en: PRAM is validated for ages 2–17 to grade severity and track response; the SpO₂ item uses the room-air value. Never delay treatment to score.

text.zh-CN: PRAM 3/12（轻度，0–3分）：胸骨上窝凹陷 0；斜角肌收缩 0；进气 1（双肺底减低）；哮鸣音 1（仅呼气相）；SpO₂（停氧试验，吸空气）93% → 1（92–94%）。较到院时下降5分。
text.en: PRAM 3/12 (mild range 0–3): suprasternal retraction 0; scalene contraction 0; air entry 1 (decreased at the bases); wheeze 1 (expiratory only); SpO₂ in room air (off-oxygen trial) 93% → 1 (92–94%). Down 5 points from arrival.

refText.zh-CN: 0 正常 / 1 肺底↓ / 2 广泛↓ / 3 消失或极微弱
0 无 / 1 仅呼气相 / 2 吸气相+呼气相 / 3 不用听诊器即可闻及或沉默肺
refText.en: 0 absent / 1 expiratory / 2 insp+exp / 3 audible without stethoscope or silent chest

text.zh-CN: PRAM 0/12：胸骨上窝凹陷 0；斜角肌收缩 0；进气 0（正常）；哮鸣音 0（平静呼吸时无）；SpO₂（吸空气）96% → 0（≥95%）。
text.en: PRAM 0/12: suprasternal retraction 0; scalene contraction 0; air entry 0 (normal); wheeze 0 (none during quiet breathing); SpO₂ in room air 96% → 0 (≥ 95%).

refText.zh-CN: 0 正常 / 1 肺底↓ / 2 广泛↓ / 3 消失或极微弱
0 无 / 1 仅呼气相 / 2 吸气相+呼气相 / 3 不用听诊器即可闻及或沉默肺
refText.en: 0 absent / 1 expiratory / 2 insp+exp / 3 audible without stethoscope or silent chest

text.zh-CN: PRAM 12/12（重度，8–12分）：胸骨上窝凹陷 2（有）；斜角肌收缩 2（有）；进气 3（极少）；哮鸣音 3（接近沉默肺，进气极少）；SpO₂ <92% → 2。较到院时的8分升高。
text.en: PRAM 12/12 (severe range 8–12): suprasternal retraction 2 (present); scalene contraction 2 (present); air entry 3 (minimal); wheeze 3 (near-silent chest with minimal air entry); SpO₂ < 92% → 2. Up from 8 on arrival.

refText.zh-CN: 0 正常 / 1 肺底↓ / 2 广泛↓ / 3 消失或极微弱
0 无 / 1 仅呼气相 / 2 吸气相+呼气相 / 3 不用听诊器即可闻及或沉默肺
refText.en: 0 absent / 1 expiratory / 2 insp+exp / 3 audible without stethoscope or silent chest

note.zh-CN: PRAM 适用于2–17岁儿童，用于分级和追踪治疗反应；SpO₂ 一项按吸空气时的数值计分。不要为评分延误治疗。
note.en: PRAM is validated for ages 2–17 to grade severity and track response; the SpO₂ item uses the room-air value. Never delay treatment to score.

name.zh-CN: 吸空气下经皮血氧饱和度（停氧试验）

text.zh-CN: 分诊时（06:05）吸空气 SpO₂ 90%，脉搏波形良好。
text.en: At triage (06:05) SpO₂ 90% in room air with a good pleth trace.

note.zh-CN: 他目前低氧，不应为做停氧试验而撤掉氧气。
note.en: He is hypoxic now — oxygen should not be withheld to repeat a room-air reading.

text.zh-CN: 停氧约10分钟后 SpO₂ 逐渐降至93%，维持在92–93%；已恢复低流量吸氧（目标94–98%）。
text.en: After about 10 min off oxygen SpO₂ drifted down to 93% and stayed at 92–93%; low-flow oxygen restarted (target 94–98%).

text.zh-CN: 已停氧；吸空气观察15分钟，SpO₂ 稳定在96%（95–97%），脉搏波形良好。
text.en: Off oxygen; observed for 15 min in room air, SpO₂ steady at 96% (range 95–97%) with a good pleth trace.

text.zh-CN: 未做停氧试验：他正在恶化、仍然低氧，不能停氧（请看监护仪上的实时SpO₂）。
text.en: No off-oxygen trial: he is deteriorating and still hypoxaemic, so oxygen must not be stopped (see the live SpO₂ on the monitor).

text.zh-CN: 3次尝试中最佳为 75 L/min，约为预计值的42%（按身高116 cm估算预计值约180 L/min；不同参考表略有差异）。配合欠佳、重复性差，仅供参考。
text.en: Best of 3 attempts 75 L/min ≈ 42% of predicted (predicted ≈ 180 L/min estimated for height 116 cm; reference charts vary). Effort poor and poorly reproducible — interpret with caution.

note.zh-CN: 急性重度发作时儿童常无法可靠完成PEF；绝不能为测PEF延误治疗。他没有个人最佳值，只能参考预计值。
note.en: PEF is often unreliable in a distressed child; never delay treatment to obtain it. He has no known personal best, so predicted values are used.

text.zh-CN: 3次中最佳 125 L/min，约为预计值的69%；配合明显改善。
text.en: Best of 3: 125 L/min ≈ 69% of predicted; much better effort.

text.zh-CN: 3次中最佳 145 L/min，约为预计值的81%（>75%）；重复性好。
text.en: Best of 3: 145 L/min ≈ 81% of predicted (> 75%); reproducible.

text.zh-CN: 无法完成：他太疲惫、喘得太厉害，吹不了峰流速。
text.en: Not possible: he is too exhausted and breathless to perform a peak flow.

text.zh-CN:
• 4岁：哮喘急性发作，儿科普通病房住院3天，需鼻导管吸氧；未入PICU，未插管。
• 过去12个月：急诊就诊2次（均为病毒感染后诱发），雾化后离院，每次开具口服泼尼松龙3天。

name.zh-CN: 静脉血气分析（含电解质、乳酸）
name.en: Venous blood gas (with electrolytes and lactate)

text.zh-CN: 静脉血：pH 7.40，pCO₂ 4.9 kPa（偏低，与过度通气相符），HCO₃⁻ 22.7 mmol/L，BE −1.6 mmol/L；Na⁺ 138、K⁺ 4.1、Cl⁻ 104 mmol/L；阴离子间隙 = 138 −（104 + 22.7）= 11.3 mmol/L；葡萄糖 6.2 mmol/L；乳酸 1.6 mmol/L。无呼吸性酸中毒。
text.en: Venous: pH 7.40, pCO₂ 4.9 kPa (37 mmHg; low, consistent with hyperventilation), HCO₃⁻ 22.7 mmol/L, BE −1.6 mmol/L; Na⁺ 138, K⁺ 4.1, Cl⁻ 104 mmol/L; anion gap = 138 − (104 + 22.7) = 11.3 mmol/L; glucose 6.2 mmol/L (112 mg/dL); lactate 1.6 mmol/L (14 mg/dL). No respiratory acidosis.

note.zh-CN: 急性哮喘患儿无危及生命表现时不常规做血气；静脉穿刺会加重哭闹和呼吸做功。呼吸急促患儿的pCO₂若“正常”或上升，提示疲劳，是危险信号。
note.en: Blood gases are not routine in a child without life-threatening features; venepuncture adds distress and work of breathing. A 'normal' or rising pCO₂ in a tachypnoeic child is a warning sign of tiring.

text.zh-CN: 静脉血：pH 7.38，pCO₂ 4.8 kPa，HCO₃⁻ 21.1 mmol/L，BE −3.3 mmol/L；Na⁺ 139、K⁺ 3.4、Cl⁻ 105 mmol/L；阴离子间隙 = 139 −（105 + 21.1）= 12.9 mmol/L；葡萄糖 8.9 mmol/L；乳酸 2.6 mmol/L。轻度低钾、高血糖和乳酸升高符合大剂量β₂激动剂作用。
text.en: Venous: pH 7.38, pCO₂ 4.8 kPa (36 mmHg), HCO₃⁻ 21.1 mmol/L, BE −3.3 mmol/L; Na⁺ 139, K⁺ 3.4, Cl⁻ 105 mmol/L; anion gap = 139 − (105 + 21.1) = 12.9 mmol/L; glucose 8.9 mmol/L (160 mg/dL); lactate 2.6 mmol/L (23 mg/dL). Mild hypokalaemia, hyperglycaemia and raised lactate fit high-dose β₂-agonist effects.

note.zh-CN: 需要频繁或持续沙丁胺醇时应监测血钾；本例无需处理。
note.en: Monitor K⁺ if frequent or continuous salbutamol is needed; no treatment required here.

text.zh-CN: 静脉血：pH 7.39，pCO₂ 5.1 kPa，HCO₃⁻ 22.7 mmol/L，BE −1.7 mmol/L；Na⁺ 138、K⁺ 3.7、Cl⁻ 104 mmol/L；阴离子间隙 = 138 −（104 + 22.7）= 11.3 mmol/L；葡萄糖 7.0 mmol/L；乳酸 1.7 mmol/L。
text.en: Venous: pH 7.39, pCO₂ 5.1 kPa (38 mmHg), HCO₃⁻ 22.7 mmol/L, BE −1.7 mmol/L; Na⁺ 138, K⁺ 3.7, Cl⁻ 104 mmol/L; anion gap = 138 − (104 + 22.7) = 11.3 mmol/L; glucose 7.0 mmol/L (126 mg/dL); lactate 1.7 mmol/L (15 mg/dL).

note.zh-CN: 危及生命的哮喘中血气有助于判断通气衰竭；不要因等待结果而延误治疗。
note.en: In life-threatening asthma a gas helps to recognise ventilatory failure; never delay treatment waiting for it.

text.en: Portable AP chest X-ray: hyperinflated lungs (right hemidiaphragm below the 10th posterior rib — 11 posterior ribs visible — with flattened diaphragms); bilateral perihilar peribronchial wall thickening (cuffing); no consolidation, collapse, pneumothorax or pneumomediastinum; normal heart size.

text.en: Not available as an emergency test; can be arranged at asthma-clinic follow-up (e.g. house dust mite, cat).

name.zh-CN: 肺功能检查（肺通气功能）

text.zh-CN: 急诊发作期不做肺功能检查：喘息时测定不可靠，也会加重孩子的不适。恢复后在哮喘专科随访时检查（如FEV₁及支气管舒张试验）。
text.en: Spirometry is not performed during an acute attack in the ED (unreliable, and distressing while he is breathless). Arrange it at asthma-clinic follow-up once he has recovered (e.g. FEV₁ with bronchodilator reversibility).

message.zh-CN: 本例不常规行动脉穿刺：如确需评估，将以静脉血气代替（动脉穿刺对哮喘发作中的患儿疼痛刺激大）。
message.en: Arterial puncture is not routinely performed in this child; a venous gas will be processed instead (arterial sampling is painful and distressing for a child in an asthma attack).

name.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇气雾剂（pMDI）+储雾罐

dose.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇 100 µg/揿，经带阀储雾罐（口含嘴）给药 6–10 揿（10揿 = 1 mg；重度发作给10揿），每揿1下后平静呼吸5–6次；第1小时每20分钟1次，共3次，之后按反应延长间隔（1–4小时一次）。
dose.en: Salbutamol 100 µg/puff via valved spacer (mouthpiece), 6–10 puffs (10 puffs = 1 mg; 10 puffs in a severe attack), one puff at a time followed by 5–6 tidal breaths; every 20 min ×3 in the first hour, then spaced (1–4-hourly) according to response.

response.zh-CN: 护士协助他通过储雾罐一揿一揿吸完10揿。几分钟后呼吸开始放缓，哮鸣音减轻；心率随之上升，手有点抖。
response.en: With the nurse's help he takes the 10 puffs through the spacer, one at a time. Within minutes his breathing starts to ease and the wheeze softens; his heart rate climbs and his hands get a little shaky.

harm.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇用得过多过快（累计超过8次，或在没有反应差/危及生命征象时前30分钟内超过3次）：反复大剂量会导致心动过速、震颤、低钾和乳酸升高，却不会带来额外获益。第1小时3次之后应先再评估，再按反应延长间隔；若确实仍需如此频繁地用药，应升级处理（呼叫上级/PICU，考虑静脉治疗），而不是继续重复同样的药。
harm.en: Too much salbutamol, too fast (more than 8 doses in total, or more than 3 in the first 30 minutes without a poor response or life-threatening features): repeated high doses cause tachycardia, tremor, hypokalaemia and raised lactate without extra benefit. After the three first-hour doses, reassess and space doses by response; if he genuinely still needs it this often, escalate (senior/PICU review, IV therapy) rather than keep repeating the same drug.

dose.zh-CN: 异丙托溴铵 250 µg 雾化（体重≤20 kg），与沙丁胺醇混合，第1小时每20分钟1次，共3次（重度发作的附加治疗）。
dose.en: Ipratropium bromide 250 µg nebulised (weight ≤ 20 kg), mixed with salbutamol, every 20 min ×3 in the first hour (add-on for severe exacerbations).

response.zh-CN: 与沙丁胺醇混合雾化完毕。
response.en: Given mixed with salbutamol through the nebuliser.

name.zh-CN: 布地奈德混悬液雾化吸入

dose.zh-CN: 布地奈德混悬液每次1 mg雾化吸入（中国儿童哮喘指南：急性发作早期可加用大剂量雾化ICS，如每6～8小时1次）。仅为辅助治疗，不能替代全身糖皮质激素；已给全身激素时，GINA和BTS不推荐常规加用。
dose.en: Budesonide nebuliser suspension 1 mg per dose (Chinese paediatric guideline: high-dose nebulised ICS may be added early in an acute attack, e.g. every 6–8 h). An adjunct only — it does not replace the systemic corticosteroid; GINA and BTS do not recommend it routinely once a systemic steroid has been given.

response.zh-CN: 护士按医嘱给他雾化了布地奈德。提醒：雾化吸入激素只是辅助，不能代替口服泼尼松龙（或静脉激素）——全身激素仍需在第1小时内给。
response.en: The nurse gives the budesonide neb. Reminder: nebulised steroid is only an adjunct and does not replace oral prednisolone (or an IV steroid) — he still needs a systemic steroid within the first hour.

name.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇氧驱动雾化吸入

dose.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇雾化液每次 2.5–5 mg（BTS：>5岁每次 2.5–5 mg；中国指南：体重≤20 kg 每次 2.5 mg、>20 kg 每次 5 mg——本例20 kg，2.5 mg 同时符合两者，5 mg 也在 BTS 范围内），氧气驱动 6–8 L/min；第1小时每20分钟1次，共3次，可与异丙托溴铵混合雾化。
dose.en: Salbutamol nebuliser solution 2.5–5 mg per dose (BTS: 2.5–5 mg for age > 5 years; Chinese guideline: 2.5 mg for weight ≤ 20 kg, 5 mg above 20 kg — at 20 kg, 2.5 mg satisfies both and 5 mg is within the BTS range), driven by oxygen at 6–8 L/min; every 20 min ×3 in the first hour; may be mixed with ipratropium.

response.zh-CN: 戴上雾化面罩时他起初有点害怕，妈妈抱着他慢慢安静下来。雾化结束时呼吸稍平稳，心率上升，手微微发抖。
response.en: He is frightened of the nebuliser mask at first, but settles in his mum's arms. By the end of the neb his breathing is a little easier, his heart rate is up and his hands have a fine tremor.

harm.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇用得过多过快（累计超过8次，或在没有反应差/危及生命征象时前30分钟内超过3次）：反复大剂量会导致心动过速、震颤、低钾和乳酸升高，却不会带来额外获益。第1小时3次之后应先再评估，再按反应延长间隔；若确实仍需如此频繁地用药，应升级处理（呼叫上级/PICU，考虑静脉治疗），而不是继续重复同样的药。
harm.en: Too much salbutamol, too fast (more than 8 doses in total, or more than 3 in the first 30 minutes without a poor response or life-threatening features): repeated high doses cause tachycardia, tremor, hypokalaemia and raised lactate without extra benefit. After the three first-hour doses, reassess and space doses by response; if he genuinely still needs it this often, escalate (senior/PICU review, IV therapy) rather than keep repeating the same drug.

name.en: Oxygen via face mask, titrated to SpO₂ 94–98%

dose.zh-CN: 经面罩或鼻导管吸氧，按需调节流量使SpO₂维持在94–98%；好转后逐步减停。
dose.en: Face mask or nasal cannula, flow adjusted to keep SpO₂ 94–98%; weaned off as he improves.

response.zh-CN: 戴上面罩后SpO₂升到94%以上。护士会按目标范围调节流量，病情好转后逐步停氧。
response.en: With the mask on his SpO₂ rises above 94%. The nurse will titrate the flow to target and wean it off as he improves.

name.zh-CN: 坐位（靠在妈妈怀里），保持安静舒适
name.en: Sit him upright on his mother's lap and keep him calm

response.zh-CN: 他靠在妈妈怀里坐直，情绪稍稍稳定。
response.en: He sits upright leaning on his mum and settles a little.

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松龙 40 mg 口服（2 mg/kg，最大40 mg），1小时内给予；之后每日1次，共3天（3–5天均可）。可用5 mg可溶片溶于水或口服液。
dose.en: Prednisolone 40 mg orally (2 mg/kg, maximum 40 mg) within the first hour; then once daily to complete 3 days (3–5 days acceptable). Soluble 5 mg tablets dispersed in water, or oral solution.

harm.zh-CN: 他已经用过静脉氢化可的松，再加一种全身激素没有额外获益，只增加不良反应。
harm.en: He has already had IV hydrocortisone — a second systemic steroid adds side-effects without benefit.

response.zh-CN: 他皱着眉喝下了溶好的药液，没有呕吐。护士提醒：激素需要几个小时才起效。
response.en: He pulls a face but swallows the dissolved tablets and keeps them down. The nurse reminds you steroids take a few hours to work.

dose.zh-CN: 氢化可的松 4 mg/kg = 80 mg 静脉注射，必要时每4–6小时重复（中国指南：琥珀酸氢化可的松每次5–10 mg/kg，或甲泼尼龙每次1–2 mg/kg = 20–40 mg，间隔4–8小时可重复）；仅用于呕吐或无法口服时。
dose.en: Hydrocortisone 4 mg/kg = 80 mg IV, repeated every 4–6 h if needed (Chinese guideline: hydrocortisone sodium succinate 5–10 mg/kg or methylprednisolone 1–2 mg/kg = 20–40 mg per dose, repeated every 4–8 h); only if vomiting or unable to take oral medication.

harm.zh-CN: 他已经口服了泼尼松龙，重复给予全身激素没有额外获益。
harm.en: He has already had oral prednisolone — repeating a systemic steroid adds no benefit.

response.zh-CN: 护士给他置入静脉留置针，他哭闹挣扎了好一阵，药物已推注。（他能吞咽、没有呕吐，口服激素同样有效。）
response.en: The nurse inserts a cannula — he cries and struggles for a while — and the dose is given. (He can swallow and isn't vomiting; oral steroid works just as well.)

dose.zh-CN: 硫酸镁 40 mg/kg = 800 mg（最大 2 g），稀释后静脉输注≥20分钟，同时监测血压。
dose.en: Magnesium sulfate 40 mg/kg = 800 mg (maximum 2 g) IV, diluted, infused over at least 20 min with blood-pressure monitoring.

response.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路后开始输注硫酸镁。他说脸有点热，血压略降后回升。
response.en: After IV access the infusion runs; he says his face feels warm, and his blood pressure dips slightly before recovering.

dose.zh-CN: 氨茶碱负荷量 5 mg/kg = 100 mg，静脉输注≥20分钟（此前未用茶碱类；心电监护下），随后以 1 mg/(kg·h) 持续输注并监测血药浓度——仅考虑用于对最大剂量吸入支气管舒张剂、全身激素和静脉硫酸镁均无反应的重度或危及生命发作，并在PICU/HDU条件下使用；GINA 不推荐在急性发作中使用。
dose.en: Aminophylline loading dose 5 mg/kg = 100 mg IV over ≥ 20 min (no prior theophylline; with ECG monitoring), then 1 mg/kg/h by infusion with level monitoring — only considered for severe or life-threatening asthma unresponsive to maximal inhaled bronchodilators, systemic steroids and IV magnesium, in a PICU/HDU setting; GINA advises against it in exacerbations.

harm.zh-CN: 他没有危及生命的表现，也不是对最大剂量吸入支气管舒张剂、全身激素和静脉硫酸镁均无反应的难治性发作：氨茶碱不会增加疗效，却有恶心呕吐、心动过速、心律失常甚至抽搐的风险。
harm.en: He has no life-threatening features and has not failed maximal therapy (inhaled bronchodilators, systemic steroid and IV magnesium): aminophylline adds no benefit here but risks vomiting, tachycardia, arrhythmia and seizures.

response.zh-CN: 输注过程中他开始恶心，心率进一步上升。
response.en: During the infusion he becomes nauseated and his heart rate climbs further.

name.zh-CN: 呼叫上级医生/儿科重症会诊
name.en: Call for senior help (paediatric registrar / PICU)

response.zh-CN: 上级医生到床旁评估，与你一起复核严重程度和下一步升级的指征。
response.en: A senior doctor comes to the bedside and reviews severity and the escalation criteria with you.

dose.zh-CN: 咪达唑仑 0.1 mg/kg = 2 mg 静脉注射（或口服水合氯醛）
dose.en: Midazolam 0.1 mg/kg = 2 mg IV (or oral chloral hydrate)

harm.zh-CN: 急性哮喘发作时禁用镇静剂（已在ICU插管机械通气者除外）：会抑制呼吸驱动，导致通气不足、CO₂潴留甚至呼吸停止。他的紧张不安来自缺氧和呼吸困难——应治疗病因。
harm.en: Sedatives are contraindicated in acute asthma (except in intubated, ventilated patients in ICU): they blunt respiratory drive and can cause hypoventilation, CO₂ retention and respiratory arrest. His distress reflects hypoxia and air hunger — treat the cause.

response.zh-CN: 几分钟后他变得昏昏欲睡，呼吸变浅变慢，监护仪上SpO₂下降、ETCO₂上升。
response.en: Within minutes he becomes drowsy, his breathing slows and shallows, SpO₂ falls and ETCO₂ rises on the monitor.

dose.zh-CN: 阿莫西林 500 mg 口服，每12小时1次（约50 mg/kg/日），疗程5天
dose.en: Amoxicillin 500 mg PO every 12 h (≈ 50 mg/kg/day) for 5 days

response.zh-CN: 护士核对医嘱时问：“开阿莫西林——是考虑有细菌感染吗？”
response.en: Checking the order, the nurse asks: “Amoxicillin — are we treating a bacterial infection?”

name.zh-CN: 吸入技术教育（储雾罐示范+回示）

response.zh-CN: 示范之后，妈妈和孩子用储雾罐回示：摇匀、每次1揿、平静呼吸5–6次，正确完成。妈妈说以后每次都用储雾罐。
response.en: After a demonstration, mother and son teach it back: shake, one puff at a time, 5–6 calm breaths — done correctly. Mum says she'll always use the spacer from now on.

name.zh-CN: 书面个体化哮喘行动计划

dose.zh-CN: 绿区（每日控制药）；黄区（症状加重：经储雾罐吸沙丁胺醇，何时需要就诊）；红区（紧急：10揿无效或需要间隔<4小时重复 → 立即呼叫急救/来急诊）。包括出院后沙丁胺醇用法（如每4小时4–6揿，1–2天后改为按需）和泼尼松龙疗程。
dose.en: Green zone (daily controller); yellow zone (worsening: salbutamol via spacer, when to seek review); red zone (emergency: no relief from 10 puffs or needing it more often than every 4 hours → call an ambulance / come to ED). Includes the post-discharge salbutamol plan (e.g. 4–6 puffs every 4 h, then as needed after 1–2 days) and the prednisolone course.

response.zh-CN: 你和妈妈逐项过了一遍行动计划，妈妈用自己的话复述了什么情况要立即回来。她说终于知道该怎么办了。
response.en: You go through the plan with mum, who repeats back in her own words when to come straight back. She says she finally knows what to do.

name.zh-CN: 每日吸入激素（控制药）并给予依从性支持
name.en: Daily inhaled corticosteroid controller with adherence support

dose.zh-CN: 丙酸氟替卡松 50 µg/揿，经储雾罐每次1揿、每日2次（100 µg/日，低剂量），每天坚持；与刷牙等日常习惯绑定，开足量处方；出院后2个工作日内复诊、1–2个月内哮喘专科随访，若依从性和吸入技术良好仍控制不佳再考虑升级。
dose.en: Fluticasone propionate 50 µg/puff via spacer, 1 puff twice daily (100 µg/day, low dose) every day; link it to tooth-brushing and prescribe enough supply; review at the post-attack visit (within 2 working days) and in asthma clinic within 1–2 months; step up only if control stays poor despite good adherence and technique.

response.zh-CN: 新的吸入激素处方已开具，妈妈同意每天早晚刷牙后给他用。
response.en: A new controller prescription is issued; mum agrees to give it every morning and evening after tooth-brushing.

name.zh-CN: 无烟家庭建议，并为家中吸烟者提供戒烟支持
name.en: Smoke-free home advice and smoking-cessation support for smokers in the household

response.zh-CN: 你解释了二手烟（包括衣物上的残留烟雾）会加重哮喘，并提供了戒烟门诊信息。妈妈说会转告家里人。
response.en: You explain that second-hand smoke (including smoke on clothes) worsens asthma and give stop-smoking service details. Mum says she'll pass it on at home.

response.zh-CN: PICU团队接收患儿，转入重症监护继续治疗和监测。
response.en: The PICU team accepts him for ongoing critical care and monitoring.

harm.zh-CN: 他有危及生命的表现，需要PICU/HDU级别的监护，不能收入普通病房。
harm.en: He has life-threatening features: he needs PICU/HDU-level care, not a general ward bed.

response.zh-CN: 儿科病房同意接收。床位准备好之前他仍在急诊由你负责——继续再评估，并在他离开急诊前完成宣教和随访安排。
response.en: The paediatric ward accepts him. Until the bed is ready he stays under your care in the ED — keep reassessing him, and complete the education and follow-up plan before he leaves.

name.zh-CN: 办理出院（附书面计划并安排随访）
name.en: Discharge home (with written plan and follow-up)

harm.zh-CN: 现在出院不安全：强化治疗后的观察期还没结束——他还没证明能在吸空气、3–4小时一次沙丁胺醇的情况下保持稳定，离院前评估（吸空气SpO₂、PEF、宣教与随访安排）也未完成。护士暂停了出院流程，他继续留在急诊。
harm.en: Discharge now is unsafe: the observation period after his intensive treatment isn't over — he hasn't shown he can stay stable in room air on 3–4-hourly salbutamol, and the pre-discharge checks (room-air SpO₂, PEF, education, follow-up) aren't done. The nurse puts the discharge on hold and he stays in the ED.

response.zh-CN: 出院小结已完成：泼尼松龙再服2天；沙丁胺醇按行动计划使用；每日吸入激素；2个工作日内基层/全科医生复诊，1–2个月内哮喘专科随访；建议接种流感疫苗；若沙丁胺醇需间隔<4小时使用或10揿无效，立即就医。
response.en: Discharge summary done: 2 more days of prednisolone; salbutamol as per the action plan; daily inhaled steroid; primary-care review within 2 working days and asthma-clinic follow-up within 1–2 months; flu vaccination advised; return immediately if salbutamol is needed more often than every 4 hours or 10 puffs don't help.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，他来了15分钟了，呼吸越来越费力，需要我先准备点什么吗？”
message.en: Nurse: “Doctor, he's been here 15 minutes and he's working harder to breathe — anything you'd like me to set up?”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“他的血氧在往下掉，呼吸越来越费力，看着开始累了！”
message.en: Nurse: “His sats are dropping and he's working even harder — he's starting to look tired!”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“他快没力气了，呼吸越来越浅，开始犯困，几乎说不出话——得马上请上级医生来！”
message.en: Nurse: “He's exhausted — his breathing is getting shallow, he's getting drowsy and can hardly speak. We need senior help now!”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“第一小时的第3次支气管舒张剂已经给完了。”
message.en: Nurse: “That's the third bronchodilator dose of the first hour done.”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“三轮雾化都做完了，他还是喘得很厉害、呼吸很快，也离不开氧气——要不要升级治疗，或者请上级来看看？”
message.en: Nurse: “That's three rounds of nebs done and he's still working hard — breathing fast and needing oxygen. Do you want to escalate treatment or get the senior to see him?”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“他来了快一个小时了，除了雾化，还有别的药要给吗？”
message.en: Nurse: “He's been here nearly an hour — any other medicines you want him to have besides the nebs?”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“他来了4个多小时了，还是喘得比较快，吸空气时血氧也不太够——要不要再看看他还缺什么治疗？”
message.en: Nurse: “He's been here over 4 hours and he's still breathing fast, with borderline sats in air — is there anything else he should be having?”

message.zh-CN: 护士：“他强化治疗后的观察还没结束，还没证明停氧、3–4小时一次沙丁胺醇也能保持稳定——我觉得现在让他回家不安全。”
message.en: Nurse: “He hasn't finished his observation after the intensive treatment and hasn't shown he can stay well off oxygen on 3–4-hourly salbutamol — I'm not comfortable sending him home yet.”

title.en: Rapid assessment: how sick is he?

hint.zh-CN: 先看后听：说话能力、呼吸做功（三凹征、辅助呼吸肌）、意识、SpO₂，再听进气和哮鸣音；用结构化评分（如PRAM）归类严重度——但不要为了评分延误治疗。一旦病情恶化，立即重新评估。
hint.en: Look before you listen: speech, work of breathing (recession, accessory muscles), conscious level and SpO₂, then air entry and wheeze; grade severity with a structured score (e.g. PRAM) — but never let scoring delay treatment. If he deteriorates, reassess at once.

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁评估患儿：观察说话、呼吸做功和意识，听诊双肺，完成PRAM评分，并在证据板上判断严重程度。
guidance.en: Go to the bedside: assess speech, work of breathing and conscious level, listen to the chest, complete a PRAM score and grade severity on the evidence board.

hint.zh-CN: 重度发作：吸入沙丁胺醇（储雾罐或氧驱动雾化）第1小时每20分钟1次×3，并加异丙托溴铵；吸氧使SpO₂ 94–98%；1小时内口服泼尼松龙（1–2 mg/kg，最大40 mg）。
hint.en: Severe attack: inhaled salbutamol (spacer or oxygen-driven nebuliser) every 20 min ×3 in the first hour plus ipratropium; oxygen to SpO₂ 94–98%; oral prednisolone (1–2 mg/kg, max 40 mg) within the hour.

guidance.zh-CN: 现在就处理支气管痉挛和低氧，并尽早给予需要数小时才起效的那种治疗。
guidance.en: Treat the bronchospasm and the hypoxia now — and give early the treatment that takes hours to work.

title.zh-CN: 趁雾化时向妈妈采集重点病史
title.en: Take a focused history from his mother while treatment runs

hint.zh-CN: 本次发作的经过与诱因、昨夜用了多少急救药、既往急诊/住院/ICU/插管史、控制药及实际依从性、过敏史，并排除异物吸入。
hint.en: Course and trigger of this attack, reliever use overnight, previous ED visits/admissions/ICU/intubation, controller medicine and actual adherence, allergies — and exclude foreign-body inhalation.

guidance.zh-CN: 孩子说话困难，向妈妈了解病史；先问与严重度和风险相关的问题。
guidance.en: He can barely talk — get the history from his mother, starting with what bears on severity and risk.

title.zh-CN: 1小时再评估：反应良好，还是需要升级？
title.en: Reassess at 1 hour: responding, or escalate?

hint.zh-CN: 用同一个结构化工具重复评估（PRAM、说话、听诊、吸空气SpO₂、PEF）。心率上升和手抖是沙丁胺醇的预期作用，不代表恶化。若反应差（仍呼吸急促、离不开氧气）或出现危及生命征象：呼叫上级、静脉硫酸镁。
hint.en: Repeat the same structured assessment (PRAM, speech, auscultation, room-air SpO₂, PEF). A rising heart rate and tremor are expected salbutamol effects, not deterioration. A poor response (still breathing fast, still needing oxygen) or life-threatening features means senior review and IV magnesium.

guidance.zh-CN: 完成第一小时的3轮支气管舒张剂后，回到床旁再评估，并决定下一步。
guidance.en: Once the first hour's three bronchodilator rounds are done, return to the bedside, reassess and decide the next step.

hint.zh-CN: 出院标准：吸空气SpO₂>94%、能维持3–4小时一次的沙丁胺醇、PEF>75%预计值（能测时）；出院前完成书面行动计划、吸入技术回示、恢复控制药，并安排2个工作日内复诊。若有顾虑（如高危因素或家庭支持不足），收入普通病房也是可以接受的处置，但同样要完成宣教和随访安排。
hint.en: Discharge criteria: room-air SpO₂ > 94%, stable on 3–4-hourly salbutamol, PEF > 75% predicted (if measurable); before he goes: written action plan, inhaler-technique teach-back, restart the controller and arrange review within 2 working days. If there are concerns (risk factors, support at home), ward admission is an acceptable disposition — the education and follow-up bundle still applies.

guidance.zh-CN: 观察他是否保持稳定，然后核对出院标准，并把这次就诊变成改善长期控制的机会。
guidance.en: Observe whether he stays stable, then check the discharge criteria — and turn this visit into a chance to fix long-term control.

prompt.zh-CN: 根据到院时的床旁初始评估，这次急性发作的严重程度是？
prompt.en: Based on your initial bedside assessment on arrival, how severe is this exacerbation?

need.zh-CN: 先评估说话能力、呼吸做功和意识状态，听诊双肺，并读取到院时的PRAM评分（本题针对到院时的初始评估）。
need.en: Assess speech, work of breathing and conscious level, listen to the chest and read the arrival PRAM score first (this question is about the initial assessment on arrival).

text.zh-CN: 轻度：回家按需用沙丁胺醇即可
text.en: Mild: home with as-needed salbutamol

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他只能说短语，RR 38、HR 140、吸空气SpO₂ 90%，有三凹征，PRAM 8分——远超轻度。
feedback.en: No. He speaks in phrases with RR 38, HR 140, room-air SpO₂ 90%, recession and a PRAM of 8 — far beyond mild.

text.zh-CN: 中度（PRAM 4–7）：先单用沙丁胺醇观察
text.en: Moderate (PRAM 4–7): salbutamol alone and observe

feedback.zh-CN: 低估了。按BTS/SIGN，>5岁儿童出现SpO₂<92%、HR>125、RR>30或不能一口气说完句子中任一项即属重度；PRAM 8分也在重度区间。重度发作需加用异丙托溴铵并尽早给全身激素（中度发作也应考虑；家中急救药已无效的患儿更应使用）——不能单用沙丁胺醇。
feedback.en: An underestimate. By BTS/SIGN, in children > 5 years any of SpO₂ < 92%, HR > 125, RR > 30 or inability to complete sentences in one breath means severe; PRAM 8 is also in the severe band. Severe attacks need ipratropium and an early systemic steroid (considered even in moderate attacks, and clearly indicated when the home reliever has failed) — salbutamol alone is not enough.

text.zh-CN: 重度（急性重度）发作，目前无危及生命征象
text.en: Acute severe exacerbation without life-threatening features

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SpO₂ 90%（<92%）、HR 140（>125）、RR 38（>30）、只能说短语、三凹征、PRAM 8/12 → 重度。神志清楚、无躁动、无发绀、不是沉默肺、血压正常、呼吸努力尚可——暂无危及生命征象，但需每15–20分钟复评。
feedback.en: Correct. SpO₂ 90% (< 92%), HR 140 (> 125), RR 38 (> 30), phrases only, recession and PRAM 8/12 → severe. He is alert, not agitated, not cyanosed, has no silent chest, normal BP and adequate effort — no life-threatening features yet, but reassess every 15–20 min.

text.zh-CN: 危及生命的发作：立即准备插管、转PICU
text.en: Life-threatening: prepare for intubation and PICU now

feedback.zh-CN: 判断过重。危及生命是指SpO₂<92%同时伴有PEF<33%、沉默肺、发绀、呼吸努力差、躁动、低血压、精疲力竭或意识改变中的任一项。他神志清楚、虽害怕但无躁动，进气虽减低但不是沉默肺、无发绀、血压正常。若治疗无反应须立即重评并升级。（若之后病情恶化——精疲力竭、嗜睡、沉默肺或治疗中SpO₂仍下降——就已达到危及生命的标准，须立即升级。）
feedback.en: Over-called. Life-threatening means SpO₂ < 92% plus any of PEF < 33%, silent chest, cyanosis, poor respiratory effort, agitation, hypotension, exhaustion or altered consciousness. He is alert and frightened but not agitated, has reduced air entry but no silent chest, is pink and normotensive. If he fails to respond, reassess and escalate at once. (If he later deteriorates — exhaustion, drowsiness, a quiet chest or falling SpO₂ despite treatment — he then meets life-threatening criteria and needs immediate escalation.)

text.zh-CN: 先做血气和胸片才能判断
text.en: Cannot grade it without a blood gas and chest X-ray

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。严重度是床旁临床判断（说话、呼吸做功、SpO₂、心率、呼吸频率、PEF），不需要也不应等待血气或胸片才开始治疗。
feedback.en: No. Severity is a bedside clinical judgement (speech, work of breathing, SpO₂, heart and respiratory rate, PEF); treatment must not wait for a gas or an X-ray.

prompt.zh-CN: 以下哪些是他现在（第1小时内）应接受的一线治疗？（多选）
prompt.en: Which of these are first-line treatments he should receive now, within the first hour? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先判断严重程度（到院时的初始评估）。
need.en: Grade severity first (initial assessment on arrival).

text.zh-CN: 吸入沙丁胺醇：储雾罐6–10揿或雾化2.5–5 mg，第1小时每20分钟1次×3
text.en: Inhaled salbutamol: 6–10 puffs via spacer or 2.5–5 mg nebulised, every 20 min ×3 in the first hour

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。吸入短效β₂激动剂是一线治疗；pMDI+储雾罐与雾化同样有效，低氧时可用氧驱动雾化。
feedback.en: Correct. Inhaled SABA is first line; pMDI + spacer is as effective as a nebuliser, and an oxygen-driven neb suits a hypoxic child.

text.zh-CN: 加用异丙托溴铵250 µg雾化，第1小时每20分钟1次×3
text.en: Add nebulised ipratropium 250 µg every 20 min ×3 in the first hour

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。重度（及中重度）发作第1小时加用异丙托溴铵可改善肺功能、减少住院。
feedback.en: Correct. In severe (and moderate–severe) attacks, first-hour ipratropium improves lung function and reduces admissions.

text.zh-CN: 吸氧，目标SpO₂ 94–98%
text.en: Oxygen to a target SpO₂ of 94–98%

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SpO₂ 90%需要控制性氧疗，好转后及时减停。
feedback.en: Correct. SpO₂ 90% needs controlled oxygen, weaned as he improves.

text.zh-CN: 1小时内口服泼尼松龙40 mg（2 mg/kg，最大40 mg）
text.en: Oral prednisolone 40 mg (2 mg/kg, max 40 mg) within the first hour

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。全身激素需数小时起效，越早给越能减少住院和复发；能口服时口服与静脉同样有效。
feedback.en: Correct. Systemic steroids take hours to act, so early doses reduce admission and relapse; oral is as effective as IV when he can swallow.

text.zh-CN: 现在就静脉给硫酸镁40 mg/kg
text.en: IV magnesium sulfate 40 mg/kg now

feedback.zh-CN: 暂不需要。静脉硫酸镁用于第一小时强化治疗（吸入支气管舒张剂×3 + 激素）后反应差或有危及生命征象的患儿。
feedback.en: Not yet. IV magnesium is for children who respond poorly to first-hour treatment (three bronchodilator rounds + steroid) or who have life-threatening features.

text.zh-CN: 先拍胸片再决定治疗
text.en: Chest X-ray before deciding on treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胸片不改变大多数哮喘发作的处理，仅在怀疑气胸/纵隔气肿、实变，危及生命或治疗无反应时考虑；绝不能延误治疗。
feedback.en: No. A chest X-ray does not change management in most attacks; consider it only for suspected pneumothorax/pneumomediastinum or consolidation, life-threatening asthma or non-response — and never before treatment.

text.zh-CN: 加用阿莫西林，因为他有低热
text.en: Add amoxicillin because he has a low-grade fever

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。诱因多为病毒，低热很常见；无细菌感染证据时不常规使用抗生素。
feedback.en: No. The trigger is usually viral and low-grade fever is common; antibiotics are not routine without evidence of bacterial infection.

text.zh-CN: 给小剂量镇静剂让他安静下来
text.en: A small dose of sedative to settle him

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。急性哮喘禁用镇静剂（ICU机械通气除外），会抑制呼吸、加重CO₂潴留。他的紧张不安是缺氧和呼吸困难的表现，应治疗病因；若出现躁动或意识改变，提示病情恶化、需要立即升级处理。
feedback.en: Dangerous. Sedation is contraindicated in acute asthma (except in ventilated ICU patients): it suppresses breathing and worsens CO₂ retention. His distress reflects hypoxia and air hunger — treat the cause; new agitation or altered consciousness signals deterioration and needs immediate escalation.

prompt.zh-CN: 治疗1小时后再评估：结合你复查的体格检查、PRAM评分和吸空气SpO₂，下一步最合适的是？
prompt.en: Reassessment after the first hour: based on your repeat examination, the PRAM score and the room-air SpO₂, what is the most appropriate next step?

need.zh-CN: 完成1小时后的再评估（再次听诊双肺并读取再评估时的PRAM评分）。
need.en: Complete the 1-hour reassessment (re-auscultate the chest and read the reassessment PRAM score).

text.zh-CN: 反应良好：继续滴定吸氧（94–98%）并逐步停氧，沙丁胺醇按需延长至1–4小时一次，停用异丙托溴铵，完成激素疗程，观察至能维持3–4小时一次用药
text.en: Good response: keep titrating oxygen (94–98%) and wean it, space salbutamol to 1–4-hourly as needed, stop ipratropium, continue the steroid course and observe until stable on 3–4-hourly doses

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。PRAM从8降到3、能说完整句子，说明对第一小时治疗反应良好；继续观察是否能维持较长的用药间隔，并逐步停氧。
feedback.en: Correct. PRAM 8 → 3 and full sentences show a good response to first-hour treatment; now see whether he holds on longer dosing intervals and wean the oxygen.

text.zh-CN: 加用静脉硫酸镁
text.en: Add IV magnesium sulfate

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要：他反应良好（PRAM 8→3）。硫酸镁用于反应差者，静脉操作本身也会增加痛苦。
feedback.en: Not needed: he is responding well (PRAM 8 → 3). Magnesium is for poor responders, and the IV itself adds distress.

text.zh-CN: 因为心率150次/分和手抖，停用沙丁胺醇
text.en: Stop salbutamol because of the heart rate of 150 and the tremor

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。心动过速和震颤是沙丁胺醇的预期不良反应，不是停药理由；随着呼吸改善、用药间隔延长会下降。需要频繁用药时注意血钾。
feedback.en: No. Tachycardia and tremor are expected salbutamol effects, not a reason to stop; they settle as breathing improves and doses are spaced. Watch potassium if dosing is frequent.

text.zh-CN: 他已经明显好转，现在就可以回家
text.en: He's much better — send him home now

feedback.zh-CN: 过早。他吸空气SpO₂仍约93%、仍需吸氧，刚完成强化治疗——需观察到能稳定维持3–4小时一次的沙丁胺醇。
feedback.en: Too early. His room-air SpO₂ is about 93%, he still needs oxygen and has just finished intensive treatment — he must be stable on 3–4-hourly salbutamol first.

text.zh-CN: 转入PICU行持续沙丁胺醇雾化
text.en: Transfer to PICU for continuous salbutamol

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要：反应良好，没有危及生命征象。
feedback.en: Not needed: he is responding well and has no life-threatening features.

prompt.zh-CN: 约4小时后：出院前必须满足哪些标准、完成哪些事项？（多选）
prompt.en: About 4 hours in: which criteria must be met, and which steps completed, before he goes home? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 进入离院前评估阶段，并读取吸空气SpO₂（停氧试验）或PRAM结果。
need.en: Reach the pre-discharge review and read the room-air SpO₂ (off-oxygen trial) or the PRAM.

text.zh-CN: 吸空气SpO₂ >94%并保持稳定
text.en: Room-air SpO₂ > 94% and stable

feedback.zh-CN: 正确（本例96%）。
feedback.en: Correct (here 96%).

text.zh-CN: 病情稳定，3–4小时一次的吸入沙丁胺醇即可控制（在家可继续）
text.en: Stable on 3–4-hourly inhaled salbutamol that can be continued at home

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。
feedback.en: Correct.

text.zh-CN: PEF >75%预计值或个人最佳值（能配合测量时）
text.en: PEF > 75% of predicted or personal best (where it can be measured)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确：PEF达到预计值或个人最佳值的75%以上，是可以离院的客观指标之一。
feedback.en: Correct: a PEF above 75% of predicted or personal best is one of the objective criteria for discharge.

text.zh-CN: 已给书面哮喘行动计划、吸入技术回示正确、开具每日控制药并安排好泼尼松龙疗程
text.en: Written action plan given, inhaler technique taught back correctly, daily controller prescribed and prednisolone course arranged

feedback.zh-CN: 正确：出院是改善长期控制、处理依从性和二手烟等风险因素的关键时机。
feedback.en: Correct: discharge is the key moment to improve long-term control and tackle risk factors such as adherence and second-hand smoke.

text.zh-CN: 安排2个工作日内基层/全科医生复诊，并在1–2个月内哮喘专科随访
text.en: Primary-care review within 2 working days and asthma-clinic follow-up within 1–2 months

feedback.zh-CN: 正确（BTS建议2个工作日内复诊）。
feedback.en: Correct (BTS recommends review within 2 working days).

text.zh-CN: 胸片必须正常
text.en: A normal chest X-ray

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要：胸片不是出院标准。
feedback.en: Not required: a chest X-ray is not a discharge criterion.

text.zh-CN: 听诊必须完全没有哮鸣音
text.en: Completely wheeze-free on auscultation

feedback.zh-CN: 不必：可以有轻微残余哮鸣音，关键是稳定的SpO₂、用药间隔和PEF。
feedback.en: Not necessary: mild residual wheeze is acceptable; what matters is stable SpO₂, dosing interval and PEF.

text.zh-CN: 心率必须 <100次/分
text.en: Heart rate below 100/min

feedback.zh-CN: 不对：沙丁胺醇引起的心动过速常见，不是留院理由。
feedback.en: No: salbutamol-related tachycardia is common and not a reason to keep him in.

text.zh-CN: 所有重度发作都必须住院观察24小时
text.en: Every severe attack needs 24 hours of inpatient observation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对：治疗反应良好、达到出院标准的患儿可以出院，前提是有安全网建议和随访。
feedback.en: No: a child who responds well and meets the criteria can go home with safety-netting and follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 询问本次发作的经过、病毒诱因和昨夜急救药的使用
text.en: Asked about the course of this attack, the viral trigger and overnight reliever use

text.zh-CN: 评估致死性哮喘的风险因素：既往住院、ICU/插管史、口服激素疗程
text.en: Assessed risk factors for fatal asthma: previous admissions, ICU/intubation, oral steroid courses

text.zh-CN: 了解长期控制：控制药、实际依从性、吸入技术和二手烟暴露
text.en: Explored long-term control: controller, actual adherence, inhaler technique and second-hand smoke

text.zh-CN: 床旁评估严重度：说话能力、呼吸做功、听诊和意识状态
text.en: Bedside severity assessment: speech, work of breathing, auscultation and conscious level

text.zh-CN: 正确判断为急性重度发作（无危及生命征象）
text.en: Correctly graded an acute severe exacerbation without life-threatening features

text.zh-CN: 到院15分钟内开始吸入支气管舒张剂并给予控制性吸氧
text.en: Started inhaled bronchodilator within 15 minutes of arrival and gave controlled oxygen

text.zh-CN: 第1小时完成3轮沙丁胺醇并联用3次异丙托溴铵
text.en: Gave three salbutamol rounds with three ipratropium doses in the first hour

text.zh-CN: 1小时内给予全身激素
text.en: Gave a systemic corticosteroid within the first hour

text.zh-CN: 1小时后用同一结构化工具再评估（PRAM+听诊）
text.en: Reassessed at 1 hour with the same structured tool (PRAM + auscultation)

text.zh-CN: 未做常规胸片、血气、血常规、CRP或血培养
text.en: Avoided routine chest X-ray, blood gas, FBC, CRP and blood culture

text.zh-CN: 未使用镇静剂，未在达到标准前让患儿出院
text.en: No sedatives, and no discharge before criteria were met

text.zh-CN: 识别反应差或病情恶化并及时升级：呼叫上级、静脉硫酸镁（危及生命时收入PICU/HDU）
text.en: Recognised a poor response or deterioration and escalated: senior review and IV magnesium (and PICU/HDU admission if life-threatening)

text.zh-CN: 未使用抗生素；仅在反应差/危及生命时才升级静脉治疗（硫酸镁、氨茶碱）
text.en: No antibiotics; IV escalation (magnesium, aminophylline) only for poor response or life-threatening features

text.zh-CN: 出院“组合包”：书面行动计划、吸入技术回示、恢复控制药、无烟建议，并明确出院标准与随访
text.en: Discharge bundle: written action plan, inhaler teach-back, controller restarted, smoke-free advice, explicit criteria and follow-up

text.zh-CN: 与焦虑、自责的母亲沟通：解释病情与计划，非评判地讨论依从性，回应激素顾虑，用回示法确认理解
text.en: Communicated with an anxious, guilty parent: explained severity and plan, discussed adherence without blame, addressed steroid fears, checked understanding by teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 好的表现：自我介绍并说明正在做什么；用通俗语言说明“这次发作比较重，但治疗有效”；不指责（如“很多家长都担心激素，我们一起想办法”）；解释低剂量吸入激素和短疗程口服激素远比失控的哮喘安全，同时承认应尽量减少口服激素疗程；回应住院担忧和对抗生素的期望（病毒诱因、无细菌感染证据）；提到二手烟；邀请提问，并请妈妈复述何时需要立即返院。
judgeGuidance.en: Good practice: introduces self and explains what is happening; plain-language summary ('this is a serious attack, and the treatment is working'); no blame ('lots of parents worry about steroids — let's work this out together'); explains that low-dose inhaled steroid and short oral courses are far safer than uncontrolled asthma while acknowledging oral courses should be minimised; addresses the fear of admission and the expectation of antibiotics (viral trigger, no sign of bacterial infection); raises second-hand smoke; invites questions and asks mum to repeat back when to return immediately.

text.zh-CN: 以适合6岁儿童的方式沟通并让他参与
text.en: Communicated with the 6-year-old in an age-appropriate way and involved him

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 好的表现：蹲下与孩子平视，用简单词语解释面罩/储雾罐（如“宇航员面罩”），允许他坐在妈妈怀里，表扬他的配合，让他亲手练习储雾罐，不在他面前讨论吓人的内容。
judgeGuidance.en: Good practice: gets down to his eye level, explains the mask/spacer in simple words (e.g. an 'astronaut mask'), lets him stay on mum's lap, praises cooperation, lets him practise the spacer himself, and avoids frightening talk in front of him.

name.zh-CN: 分诊护士 周敏（化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班：06:05到院的6岁男孩，妈妈陪同；分诊称重20 kg。夜间咳嗽、喘息加重。分诊时RR 38、HR 140、吸空气SpO₂ 90%、T 37.6 ℃，只能说短语；分诊2级，已安置在抢救区并接上监护。妈妈带了蓝色急救喷雾，但没带储雾罐——科室有带阀储雾罐（面罩和口含嘴型）、氧驱动雾化器和壁式氧气；药房有泼尼松龙5 mg可溶片。护士可协助给药和雾化、每15–20分钟复测生命体征、协助PRAM评分、停氧试验和PEF测量、指导吸入技术。不知道检查结果之外的信息，不做诊断。
knowledge.en: Handover: 6-year-old boy who arrived at 06:05 with his mother; weighed 20 kg at triage. Cough and wheeze worse overnight. At triage RR 38, HR 140, SpO₂ 90% in room air, T 37.6 °C, speaking in phrases; triage category 2, placed in a resus cubicle on the monitor. Mum brought his blue reliever but not the spacer — the department stocks valved spacers (mask and mouthpiece), oxygen-driven nebulisers and wall oxygen; pharmacy has prednisolone 5 mg soluble tablets. The nurse can give medicines and nebs, repeat observations every 15–20 min, help with PRAM scoring, the off-oxygen trial and PEF, and coach inhaler technique. She knows nothing beyond the chart and results and does not make diagnoses.

name.zh-CN: 儿科急诊主治医师 何医生（化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教：引导学习者依据BTS/SIGN、GINA和中国儿童哮喘指南判断严重度，给出第1小时的治疗组合，识别升级指征（反应差→静脉硫酸镁、上级/PICU会诊；危及生命征象），以及出院标准和长期控制的薄弱环节（依从性、吸入技术、二手烟、无行动计划）。不直接给答案，只讨论学习者已经获得的信息。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor: guides the learner, using BTS/SIGN, GINA and the Chinese paediatric asthma guideline, to grade severity, assemble the first-hour treatment bundle, recognise escalation triggers (poor response → IV magnesium, senior/PICU review; life-threatening features) and the discharge criteria, and to spot the weak points in long-term control (adherence, technique, second-hand smoke, no action plan). Never gives answers outright and discusses only information the learner already has.

knowledge.zh-CN: 仅在学习者已拿到胸片后解读，以报告原文为准：可讲解过度充气和支气管壁增厚在哮喘发作中常见，以及胸片主要用于排查气胸、纵隔气肿或实变；会提醒急性哮喘不常规拍胸片。
knowledge.en: Interprets the chest X-ray only once the learner has it, in the report's own words: can explain that hyperinflation and peribronchial thickening are common in acute asthma and that the film is looked at for pneumothorax, pneumomediastinum or consolidation; will point out that chest X-rays are not routine in acute asthma.

knowledge.zh-CN: 按体重20 kg核对剂量：沙丁胺醇雾化2.5–5 mg或pMDI 100 µg/揿 6–10揿；异丙托溴铵250 µg；泼尼松龙2 mg/kg、最大40 mg（3天疗程）；硫酸镁40 mg/kg（800 mg，最大2 g）静脉≥20分钟；氢化可的松4 mg/kg（80 mg）；氨茶碱负荷5 mg/kg（100 mg）。提醒镇静剂禁用、抗生素不常规使用，氟替卡松50 µg/揿每次1揿每日2次为低剂量。不讨论诊断。
knowledge.en: Checks doses for 20 kg: salbutamol 2.5–5 mg nebulised or 100 µg/puff pMDI 6–10 puffs; ipratropium 250 µg; prednisolone 2 mg/kg, max 40 mg (3-day course); magnesium sulfate 40 mg/kg (800 mg, max 2 g) IV over ≥ 20 min; hydrocortisone 4 mg/kg (80 mg); aminophylline loading 5 mg/kg (100 mg). Reminds that sedatives are contraindicated, antibiotics are not routine, and fluticasone 50 µg 1 puff twice daily is a low dose. Does not discuss the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 儿童支气管哮喘急性发作（重度）——病毒诱发，控制药依从性差
title.en: Acute severe asthma exacerbation in a child — viral trigger on a background of poor controller adherence

conclusion.zh-CN: 6岁男孩，已知哮喘，长期吸入激素依从性差（两个月前停用），鼻病毒感染后夜间急性发作。到院时只能说短语，RR 38、HR 140、吸空气SpO₂ 90%，三凹征，PEF约为预计值的42%，PRAM 8/12——急性重度发作，无危及生命征象。经吸氧、第1小时3轮沙丁胺醇+异丙托溴铵和早期口服泼尼松龙，1小时PRAM降至3，约4小时时吸空气SpO₂ 96%、PEF约81%、PRAM 0，达到出院标准。出院时完成书面行动计划、吸入技术回示、恢复每日吸入激素、无烟建议，并安排2个工作日内复诊。
conclusion.en: A 6-year-old with known asthma and poor inhaled-steroid adherence (stopped two months ago) had an acute attack overnight after a rhinovirus infection. On arrival he spoke in phrases with RR 38, HR 140, room-air SpO₂ 90%, recession, PEF ≈ 42% predicted and PRAM 8/12 — an acute severe exacerbation without life-threatening features. Oxygen, three first-hour rounds of salbutamol plus ipratropium and early oral prednisolone brought PRAM to 3 at 1 hour; by about 4 hours he had room-air SpO₂ 96%, PEF ≈ 81% and PRAM 0, meeting discharge criteria. He went home with a written action plan, inhaler teach-back, his daily inhaled steroid restarted, smoke-free advice and review within 2 working days.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 严重度在床旁几分钟内判断：说话能力、呼吸做功、SpO₂、心率、呼吸频率、PEF和结构化评分（PRAM）。任何一项重度特征都按重度处理；同时主动寻找危及生命征象（沉默肺、发绀、精疲力竭、意识改变、低血压）。
keyReasoning.en: Severity is judged at the bedside within minutes: speech, work of breathing, SpO₂, heart and respiratory rate, PEF and a structured score (PRAM). Any severe feature means treat as severe — and actively look for life-threatening signs (silent chest, cyanosis, exhaustion, altered consciousness, hypotension).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一线治疗针对三件事：支气管痉挛（反复吸入沙丁胺醇+第1小时异丙托溴铵）、低氧（滴定吸氧至94–98%）和气道炎症（早期口服激素——起效需数小时，所以必须早给）。
keyReasoning.en: First-line treatment targets three things: bronchospasm (repeated inhaled salbutamol + first-hour ipratropium), hypoxia (oxygen titrated to 94–98%) and airway inflammation (early oral steroid — it takes hours to work, so give it early).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 1小时用同一工具再评估（PRAM 8→3）决定方向：反应好就延长用药间隔、停氧观察；反应差才升级（静脉硫酸镁、上级/PICU）。心动过速、手抖、轻度低钾、高血糖和乳酸升高是沙丁胺醇的预期作用。
keyReasoning.en: Reassessment at 1 hour with the same tool (PRAM 8 → 3) sets the direction: a good response means spacing doses and weaning oxygen; only a poor response triggers escalation (IV magnesium, senior/PICU). Tachycardia, tremor, mild hypokalaemia, hyperglycaemia and raised lactate are expected salbutamol effects.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胸片、血气、血常规、CRP、血培养和抗生素都不会改变这次处理：诱因是病毒，低热常见，激素后的中性粒细胞增多不是感染。
keyReasoning.en: Chest X-ray, blood gas, FBC, CRP, blood culture and antibiotics would not change management: the trigger is viral, low-grade fever is common, and post-steroid neutrophilia is not infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这次发作是“可预防的”：停用控制药、不用储雾罐、无书面行动计划、二手烟暴露、一年内2次急诊+2个口服激素疗程——都是未来严重发作的风险因素，出院时必须逐一处理。
keyReasoning.en: This attack was largely preventable: controller stopped, no spacer, no written plan, second-hand smoke, and 2 ED visits plus 2 oral steroid courses in a year — all risk factors for future severe attacks that must be addressed before discharge.

boundaries.zh-CN: 本病例聚焦学龄儿童已知哮喘的一次急诊发作处理。不涵盖≤5岁学龄前儿童喘息、首次喘息的鉴别诊断、危及生命/濒死哮喘的高级处理（静脉沙丁胺醇持续输注、无创通气、插管）——只要求识别升级指征；长期阶梯治疗的调整应在随访时完成。若延误支气管舒张剂，模拟中患儿会先出现疲劳（第1小时后反应差，须静脉硫酸镁和上级评估才能进入再评估），继续延误则进入“病情恶化”阶段（危及生命的发作：嗜睡、接近沉默肺、呼吸性酸中毒），此时病例以升级治疗并收入PICU/HDU结束，而不是出院。若有高危因素或家庭支持不足，完成同样的宣教后收入普通病房也是可接受的处置。
boundaries.en: This case covers ED management of one exacerbation in a school-age child with established asthma. It does not cover preschool wheeze (≤ 5 years), work-up of a first wheeze, or advanced management of life-threatening/near-fatal asthma (IV salbutamol infusion, NIV, intubation) beyond recognising escalation triggers; long-term step changes belong to follow-up. If bronchodilators are delayed the simulated child first tires (a poor response at 1 hour that needs IV magnesium and senior review before the reassessment can start); with further delay he enters a deterioration phase (life-threatening asthma: drowsy, near-silent chest, respiratory acidosis) and the case then ends with escalation and PICU/HDU admission instead of discharge. Ward admission after the same education bundle is an acceptable alternative disposition when risk factors or support at home are a concern.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 剂量（20 kg）：沙丁胺醇pMDI 100 µg/揿经储雾罐6–10揿或雾化2.5–5 mg，第1小时每20分钟×3；异丙托溴铵250 µg×3；泼尼松龙1–2 mg/kg（最大40 mg）共3–5天；反应差时静脉硫酸镁40 mg/kg（最大2 g）≥20分钟。
teachingPoints.en: Doses (20 kg): salbutamol pMDI 100 µg/puff via spacer 6–10 puffs or 2.5–5 mg nebulised, every 20 min ×3 in the first hour; ipratropium 250 µg ×3; prednisolone 1–2 mg/kg (max 40 mg) for 3–5 days; for poor response IV magnesium sulfate 40 mg/kg (max 2 g) over ≥ 20 min.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: pMDI+储雾罐与雾化同样有效；6岁儿童通常可用口含嘴储雾罐：每次1揿、平静呼吸5–6次，不要一次连按多揿。
teachingPoints.en: pMDI + spacer is as effective as a nebuliser; most 6-year-olds can use a mouthpiece spacer: one puff at a time with 5–6 tidal breaths, never several puffs at once.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 儿童急性哮喘禁用镇静剂（已插管机械通气者除外）；氨茶碱仅考虑用于对最大剂量吸入治疗、全身激素和静脉硫酸镁均无反应的重度或危及生命发作，需心电监护并在重症监护条件下使用（GINA 不推荐）。
teachingPoints.en: Sedatives are contraindicated in acute asthma (outside intubated, ventilated care); aminophylline is only considered for severe or life-threatening asthma unresponsive to maximal inhaled therapy, systemic steroids and IV magnesium, with ECG monitoring in a critical-care setting (GINA advises against it).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 出院标准：吸空气SpO₂>94%、稳定于3–4小时一次的沙丁胺醇、PEF>75%预计值/个人最佳（能测时）；残余轻微哮鸣音和沙丁胺醇相关心动过速不是留院理由。
teachingPoints.en: Discharge criteria: room-air SpO₂ > 94%, stable on 3–4-hourly salbutamol, PEF > 75% predicted/best (if measurable); mild residual wheeze and salbutamol-related tachycardia are not reasons to stay.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 每次急诊发作都是“哨点事件”：检查依从性（取药记录）、吸入技术、诱因和二手烟，给书面行动计划，恢复/调整控制药，2个工作日内复诊，并建议接种流感疫苗。
teachingPoints.en: Every ED attack is a sentinel event: check adherence (refill record), technique, triggers and smoke exposure; give a written action plan; restart or adjust the controller; arrange review within 2 working days; recommend flu vaccination.
